title: if you are expecting the taste and texture of regular tofu, you will be sorely disappointed !!
text: if you are expecting the taste and texture of regular tofu, you will be sorely disappointed !!. To all the people unfairly bashing this item giving it one star, that is exactly what  Koyadofu  supposed to look/feel/taste like… You cannot use this the same as regular tofu, you have to rehydrate it, then simmer it with dashi and seasonings.  It is an Integral part of our Shojin Ryori, or temple cuisine here in Japan.  Named after the sacred Mt Koya,  this is a unique preparation to enjoy tofu and the sponge like texture it makes it a great meat substitute  when crumbled in hamburgers, mapo dofu, etc.  it seems a bit unfair so many people have given this item a bad rap when that is no fault of the manufacture, it is more of the unfamiliarity with the product.
